utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that—what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center works for me. Mid-morning, if that’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sunday mid-morning works for me — I can bring filler and patch mix. What time should we meet at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t checked yet, but I can swing by and see what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? And where should folks drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m thinking late morning would work best, maybe around 10. We can have folks drop things off at my place on Maple, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — that sounds helpful. If I notice the reminder, I’ll try to stop by later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah. If you see the reminder, could you bring patch mix or filler on Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can try to bring patch mix or filler on Sunday if I remember the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—I’ll ask around and let you know what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — just pass it on when you know, and I’ll keep it simple on my end too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll check around and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve been keeping track of the supplies for the repair drive, so just tell me what you still need and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — we’re still set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m mainly checking for basic tools, strong tape, hammers, and any spare screws or nails.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll check what we have for tools, tape, hammers, and spare screws or nails, and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — Sunday at the community center helps. I just want to make sure everyone knows the new drop-off spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help spread the word about the new drop-off spot and time. Just send me the details and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll send the Sunday community center details over. That should help everyone get it to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll note that down. I can also check the spots that still need fixing before then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Sunday at the community center, right? And you’ll check which spots still need fixing before then?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that’s right—Sunday at the community center. I’ll check which spots still need fixing before then and note them down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check that for you—I'll see if we're still short on tape, screwdrivers, or nails, and I'll ask when the repair drive is happening too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that’d be really helpful. I can bring the patch mix and filler, and help coordinate drop-offs once you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Mara—I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear what’s still needed and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits from the neighbors, so I’m not totally sure. Do you know what they still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask around and let you know. If you want, I can also help spread the word a little.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help a lot. Please let me know if you hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, the community hall bulletin board is fine for the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll check the bulletin board—what time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure on the time yet—could you check with Opal or whoever posted it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’ll try to make it to the repair drive on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet, sorry — I’m still trying to sort a few things out. I’ll check if I can before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help out—what do you need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great—mostly we just need patch mix, filler, and someone to help sort the drop-offs. Sounds like it’s getting a good response already.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help sort the drop-offs, and I’ll bring some patch mix if I can find it. Just let me know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help—what’s still needed for the repair drive, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still asking around, but I’ll let you know what they still need. I did hear the repair drive’s getting a few more donations than expected, so it may be in pretty good shape.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear—keep me posted on what they still need, and I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time is the repair drive happening and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure on the exact time yet—can you check the flyer or update me? People should drop things off at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can check the flyer, but can you at least confirm the drop-off window if you know it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara — that really helps. I can keep spreading the word a bit if that would be useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Rey — thanks. I’ll bring the patch mix and filler, and I can help keep track of who’s dropping things off too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll keep spreading the word, and let me know if you need anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time is the repair drive happening? I can work around the school schedule once I know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s Sunday at the community center, starting at 9. Thanks for working around school — I’ll bring the patch mix and filler.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at 9 at the community center works for me—I’ll plan around school. If you want, I can help check the cracks first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive for a bit, and I’ll remind the others too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, great — sounds like it’s getting a good turnout. I’ll keep an ear out for any last-minute updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, I appreciate that. I’ll let the others know, and I’ll swing by for a bit if I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear of a list or any more changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Nell. Just let me know once you’ve got the list or a time nailed down, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I heard it moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll keep checking for the list and any other updates.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on a few basics, but the screwdrivers, hammer, duct tape, and boxes are covered now. If you can help spread the word, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can spread the word and help get the last few basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — that’d really help. If you hear anyone who can bring the last few basics, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries—I can still bring the screwdrivers, hammer, duct tape, and a few sturdy boxes. Just let me know if anything else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That covers a lot—if you can also bring some extra nails and a flashlight, that’d help. I’ll jump in and see what else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, right? I just want to be sure before I bring anything over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. I’ll stop by if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I’ll plan for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll bring things over if I can get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds like it’s on today—just point me to what needs doing, and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, it’s happening today! I’ll check what items are still needed and ask a few neighbors what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—just let me know what’s still needed, and I can help spread the word or grab a few things.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already started telling a few neighbors about the repair drive, and I’ll keep spreading the word. The more hands, the better!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’m glad you’re spreading the word. Can you remind me what still needs fixing and when the repair drive is again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I can remind you, though I don’t have the full list handy right this second. I do know the repair drive is today, and I’m still spreading the word to a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it noted as Sunday at the community center. If you want, I can also keep track of what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks—yeah, that’d help. I can try to swing by and bring whatever’s still needed, if I can remember.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ll keep track of the missing items and let you know what still needs bringing.
